name: Hugging Face models and datasets
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Use fresh HF_HOME and HF_XET_CACHE, and empty output directories. HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 selects the ordinary Hub/LFS path unless the server has Xet enabled.
prerequisites: The pinned hf CLI. Model and dataset source directories each containing config.json and optional weight/data files.

configure.code:
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export HF_ENDPOINT="$AW_URL/artifactory/api/huggingfaceml/$AW_REPO"
export HF_TOKEN="$AW_TOKEN"
export HF_HOME="$AW_WORK/hub"
export HF_XET_CACHE="$AW_WORK/xet"
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1

publish.note: Models and datasets use distinct hf:// destinations; publication creates the named revision through the commit API.

steps.code:
hf cp model/config.json hf://acme/demo/config.json
hf cp dataset/config.json hf://datasets/acme/demo/config.json

install.note: Download to a fresh target directory so local snapshots cannot satisfy the request.

steps.code:
hf download acme/demo --repo-type model --local-dir "$AW_WORK/model" --max-workers 1
hf download acme/demo --repo-type dataset --local-dir "$AW_WORK/dataset" --max-workers 1

limitations: Xet requires ARTIFACTWEAVE_HUGGINGFACE_XET_ENABLED on the server and HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=0 on the client; the dedicated Xet acceptance lane verifies CAS transport.
Remote and virtual recipes resolve existing content; publish to a concrete local/federated repository.

Legacy timestamp-layout migration is an administrator-only, bounded per-revision operation; use docs/operations/huggingface-migration.md to verify revision properties, permission equivalence and recovery before publication.

contains: Hub client resolves through a virtual member
Hub client resolves remote content from cache while upstream is offline
